轻录 v0.1.0，适用于 Windows 10 22H2 及以上的 64 位系统。

- 支持全屏和区域录制，视频保存为 MP4。
- 系统声音与麦克风可独立开关，并保留混音、系统声和麦克风三条音轨。
- 通过悬浮窗查看录制时间、控制声音、截图和停止录制。
- 支持自定义输出尺寸和中英文界面切换。

下载 `ScreenRecorderLite-win-x64.zip`，完整解压后运行 `ScreenRecorderLite.exe`，请保留解压后的全部文件。SHA-256 校验文件及 FFmpeg 对应源码见版本附件。

---

ScreenRecorderLite v0.1.0 for 64-bit Windows 10 22H2 and later.

- Full-screen and region recording saved as MP4.
- Independent system-audio and microphone controls, with mixed and isolated audio tracks.
- Floating controls for elapsed time, audio, screenshots and stopping the recording.
- Custom output sizes and Chinese/English interface options.

Download `ScreenRecorderLite-win-x64.zip`, extract the complete folder and run
`ScreenRecorderLite.exe`. Keep all extracted files together. SHA-256 checksums
and the corresponding FFmpeg source are included in the release assets.
